effect_text:
[When Digivolving] You may trash 1 card in your hand. If you do, you may return 1 [Mirei Mikagura] trait or 1 card with the [Angel], [Archangel] or [Fallen Angel] trait from your trash to your hand.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When you play [Angewomon] or [Mirei Mikagura], gain 1 memory.
inherited_text: [Opponent's Turn] While you have a yellow Digimon in play, all of your Digimon with the [Angel], [Archangel] or [Fallen Angel] trait gain ＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.).
